query_evidence.sql:
WITH m(month, ms, me) AS (VALUES ('2026-04','2026-04-01T00:00:00Z','2026-05-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-05','2026-05-01T00:00:00Z','2026-06-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-06','2026-06-01T00:00:00Z','2026-07-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-07','2026-07-01T00:00:00Z','2026-08-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-08','2026-08-01T00:00:00Z','2026-09-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-09','2026-09-01T00:00:00Z','2026-10-01T00:00:00Z')),
ok AS (SELECT t.txn_id, t.session_id, t.checkout_event_id, t.type, MIN(h.effective_at) AS succeeded_at
       FROM transactions t JOIN payment_status_history h ON h.txn_id = t.txn_id AND h.status = 'succeeded'
       WHERE t.type IN ('subscription','ppv') GROUP BY t.txn_id)
SELECT m.month, sum(ok.session_id IS NOT NULL) AS in_app_purchases,
       sum(ok.session_id IS NOT NULL AND ok.checkout_event_id IS NULL) AS in_app_without_checkout_link,
       sum(ok.session_id IS NULL) AS off_session_charges
FROM m LEFT JOIN ok ON ok.succeeded_at >= m.ms AND ok.succeeded_at < m.me
GROUP BY m.month ORDER BY m.month
